name: Muhammad Rahim Khan II of Khiva
wikipedia: Muhammad Rahim Khan II of Khiva
contribution: Khan of Khiva of the Uzbek ”Kongirad” Dynasty from 1864 to 1910, succeeding his father Sayyid Muhammad Khan.
legacy: The reign of this person marked the peak of a cultural revival, during which "more than a hundred works were translated, mostly from Persian into Chagatai Turkic."

checks.lead: Sayyid Muhammad Rahim Bahadur Khan II (c. 1847 – 1910) was Khan of Khiva of the Uzbek ”Kongirad” Dynasty from 1864 to 1910, succeeding his father Sayyid Muhammad Khan. Khiva was turned into a Russian protectorate during his rule, in 1873.
